requirement: Implement a restaurant menu, table reservation, and kitchen dietary allergen CRUD platform. Managers maintain menu items with ingredient lists and mandatory allergen declarations, guests book dining tables by party size and time slot, and staff filter dishes by allergen restrictions.
expected_functional_reqs: CRUD for menu categories, dishes, ingredients, allergen tags, and table reservations
Table capacity and dining slot availability validation for party bookings
Dietary filter endpoint returning dishes safe for selected allergen exclusions
Interactive digital menu with allergen badges and reservation booking form UI

tasks.title: Define menu_items, allergens, dining_tables, and reservations schema
Build menu CRUD, allergen exclusion filter, and table booking API
depends_on: Define menu_items, allergens, dining_tables, and reservations schema

tasks.title: Create allergen-filterable menu grid and table reservation UI
depends_on: Build menu CRUD, allergen exclusion filter, and table booking API

tasks.title: Verify allergen exclusion accuracy and table capacity booking constraints
depends_on: Build menu CRUD, allergen exclusion filter, and table booking API

acceptance_criteria: Filtering out peanut or gluten allergens excludes all dishes tagged with those allergens
Booking a party size larger than any available table capacity returns HTTP 422
Menu price updates validate positive decimal amounts
security_reqs: Restrict menu item and allergen tag edits to authenticated manager accounts
Rate-limit public reservation creation endpoints against automated spam

requirement: Build a verified-purchaser product review, star rating aggregation, and moderation pipeline. Only customers with a delivered order containing the product can submit a verified review, helpfulness votes are deduplicated per user, and product average ratings update automatically.
expected_functional_reqs: Review submission endpoint verifying completed order history for verified_purchase badge
Bayesian/weighted average rating and star histogram aggregation per product
Moderation queue for flagged reviews and one-vote-per-user helpfulness counter
Product rating breakdown, review filter, and submission form UI

tasks.title: Design product_reviews, review_votes, and moderation_flags schema
Implement verified-purchase review creation, voting, and rating aggregation API
depends_on: Design product_reviews, review_votes, and moderation_flags schema

tasks.title: Create star rating histogram, review list, and moderation UI
depends_on: Implement verified-purchase review creation, voting, and rating aggregation API

tasks.title: Test duplicate review prevention and verified purchase badge logic
depends_on: Implement verified-purchase review creation, voting, and rating aggregation API

acceptance_criteria: Each customer can submit at most one review per product (HTTP 409 on duplicate)
verified_purchase is set to true only when a delivered order line exists for that user and product
Rejecting a flagged review removes it from public product rating averages
security_reqs: Compute verified_purchase server-side from order records; ignore any client-supplied flag
Sanitize review title and body text against HTML/script injection

requirement: Implement a feature flag evaluation and progressive rollout REST API inspired by unleash/unleash#5490. Support boolean and multivariate flags, percentage-based deterministic user bucketing, environment-specific overrides (dev, staging, prod), and an audit log of flag state mutations.
expected_functional_reqs: REST CRUD for feature flags, targeting rules, and environment toggles
Deterministic hashing endpoint evaluating flag state for a given user_id and context
Immutable audit trail recording every flag toggle and rollout percentage update

tasks.title: Create feature_flags, targeting_rules, and flag_audit_logs tables
Implement deterministic rollout evaluation and flag management API
depends_on: Create feature_flags, targeting_rules, and flag_audit_logs tables

tasks.title: Build feature flag toggle dashboard and rollout slider UI
depends_on: Implement deterministic rollout evaluation and flag management API

tasks.title: Test deterministic bucketing consistency across 1,000 user contexts
depends_on: Implement deterministic rollout evaluation and flag management API

acceptance_criteria: Evaluating the same user_id and flag key always yields the same bucket result
A 30% rollout rule enables the flag for approximately 30% of distinct user IDs
Every mutation to production environment rules creates an audit log entry
security_reqs: Separate read-only client SDK evaluation tokens from admin mutation credentials
Validate targeting attribute payloads against schema injection

requirement: Build a promotional coupon and tiered cart discount calculation engine adapted from medusajs/medusa#6120. Support percentage, fixed-amount, and buy-X-get-Y coupons with minimum subtotal thresholds, per-customer usage caps, expiration windows, and atomic redemption counters during checkout.
expected_functional_reqs: Admin CRUD for discount campaigns, coupon codes, and eligibility rules
Cart pricing calculator applying valid coupons and returning itemized line discounts
Atomic coupon redemption tracking preventing overuse beyond maximum redemptions
Checkout UI coupon input widget with real-time savings breakdown

tasks.title: Design coupons, coupon_redemptions, and cart_items database tables
Implement discount rule evaluator and atomic redemption API
depends_on: Design coupons, coupon_redemptions, and cart_items database tables

tasks.title: Build cart summary and promo code application UI components
depends_on: Implement discount rule evaluator and atomic redemption API

tasks.title: Write boundary and race-condition tests for coupon redemptions
depends_on: Implement discount rule evaluator and atomic redemption API

acceptance_criteria: Expired or minimum-spend-unmet coupons return HTTP 400 with clear reason codes
Discount calculation never reduces order total below zero
Per-customer usage limits block repeat redemption of single-use promo codes
security_reqs: Recalculate all cart totals and discounts strictly server-side; ignore client-supplied prices
Enforce transactional locking when incrementing coupon redemption counts

requirement: Implement an organization-scoped Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and team invitation system inspired by ory/kratos#3319. Organization owners can define custom roles with fine-grained resource-action permissions, invite members via signed expiring tokens, and enforce permission checks on API endpoints.
expected_functional_reqs: Multi-tenant organization, role, permission, and membership management APIs
Cryptographically signed email invitation flow with 48-hour expiration
FastAPI dependency guard checking user permissions against resource:action policies
Organization members and role matrix administration UI

tasks.title: Design organizations, roles, permissions, memberships, and invitations schema
Implement RBAC policy evaluation guard and team invitation endpoints
depends_on: Design organizations, roles, permissions, memberships, and invitations schema

tasks.title: Build interactive role-permission matrix and member invite UI
depends_on: Implement RBAC policy evaluation guard and team invitation endpoints

tasks.title: Test privilege escalation prevention and cross-tenant isolation
depends_on: Implement RBAC policy evaluation guard and team invitation endpoints

acceptance_criteria: Users cannot assign a role containing permissions they do not themselves possess
Expired or already-accepted invitation tokens return HTTP 410 Gone
Cross-organization resource requests return HTTP 403 Forbidden
security_reqs: Prevent privilege escalation during role creation and invitation assignment
Enforce strict tenant_id scoping on every query in the RBAC guard

requirement: Create a schema registry and SQL migration versioning tracker database application inspired by liquibase/liquibase#5104. Track applied migrations per environment with SHA-256 script checksums, detect out-of-order or modified migration drift, and provide a dependency graph of schema changesets.
expected_functional_reqs: Register migration changesets with SQL up/down scripts and SHA-256 checksums
Environment drift detector flagging checksum mismatches or missing prerequisite migrations
Migration execution history and changeset DAG visualization UI

tasks.title: Design schema_changesets and environment_migration_runs database tables
Implement SHA-256 checksum validation and environment drift detection API
depends_on: Design schema_changesets and environment_migration_runs database tables

tasks.title: Build environment migration status matrix and drift alert UI
depends_on: Implement SHA-256 checksum validation and environment drift detection API

tasks.title: Audit SQL script storage and test checksum tamper detection
depends_on: Implement SHA-256 checksum validation and environment drift detection API

acceptance_criteria: Modifying an already-applied changeset script triggers a checksum drift error
Applying a changeset whose prerequisite changeset is unapplied returns HTTP 409
Environment comparison view lists pending and drifted migrations per target DB
security_reqs: Verify SHA-256 checksums before marking any changeset run as verified
Never execute arbitrary user-supplied DDL on the registry host database itself
